interface.applicability: Interactive tasks with public bounded actions and an explicit commitment contract. Exact text values and effect transitions are stronger than appearance-based inference. Missing visual features are unknown. Once an affordable grounded probe exists, a local commitment guard requires addressing the unmet obligation. No world action is silently replaced; no guarantee of visual truth.
interface.description: Node d: frozen subject domains, atomic predicates, independent quantifiers and temporal witnesses, logical composition, conditional commitment and reserved final decision. No task-specific controller.
